why: D11 of #470, AC of #472: mhw status prints a NODE line first, naming the running node against engines.node. The original printed none. It is the one intended difference of S01, allowed on the status case only, and only as an added line.

S04 (#475): the allow list's script kind rendered an Edit deny on the installed milestone-read.py in every tier; the route kind that replaces it names no file, so ~/.claude/settings.json loses exactly that one deny (measured by diffing the two installs). Its content is compared by kind and mode only, and only while the base still ships milestone-read.py; global/allow-list.test.sh asserts the rendered rules themselves.

S11 (#482): the Kiro deny floor is rendered by src/render/kiro-permissions.js, whose provenance text names itself where kiro_permissions.py named global/kiro/kiro_permissions.py: the managed-by header of permissions.yaml and the _ field of kiro-permissions-owned.json (measured by diffing the two installs: exactly these two files differ). The rules in both are the same, and test/golden/S11/ holds them byte for byte against the original. Compared by kind and mode only, and only while the base still ships kiro_permissions.py.
